title: Triage tells the user about a mail that asks them to choose by a deadline

messages.subject: Room for your workshop on 14 March
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

We have two rooms free for your workshop on 14 March: the Garden Room (20 people, 180 EUR) or the Loft (35 people, 260 EUR). Could you tell us by Thursday which one you want? We release the hold after that.

Best,
Rowan Hart
Harbour Hall

contains: Room for your workshop on 14 March

rubric: Does the notice say, in one short line, that the user must choose a room by Thursday?
